10089|0e051c59.name: Silvaria
10089|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

10219|572db4df.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
10219|572db4df.text: May Elune walk with you, $c.  The Temple of the Moon has come to help the troubled citizens of Auberdine.

11081|cb7eee8e.name: Faldron
11081|cb7eee8e.text: Many animals lost their lives so that we could gain these materials. Do not take their sacrifice lightly, $N. Handle the leather with the respect it deserves.

11083|9dd7b921.name: Darianna
11083|9dd7b921.text: Oh, I'm sorry, but you know more about leather than I do at this point. Talk to Faldron over there if you wish to learn more.

11096|904d1c22.name: Randal Worth
11096|904d1c22.text: There's nothing I can teach you, other than maybe a better eye for color and detail. Talk to Simon Tanner over there; he knows a lot of advanced techniques for working with leather.

11865|7022eed4.name: Buliwyf Stonehand
11865|7022eed4.text: Ye want to be trained in the use of a weapon, do ye?  Well don't stand there slack-jawed, speak up laddie!

11867|3f5ede7c.name: Woo Ping
11867|3f5ede7c.text: Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?

1239|c86281a7.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
1239|c86281a7.text: If you're willing to endure tales that will shiver your timbers and sog your skivvies, then get yourself a drink and sit for a spell...

1244|245cbd71.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|245cbd71.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one. Although I have many names, I answer to few. But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken... for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.

12577|c5ceacbe.name: Jarrodenus
12577|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1292|ec1a6e0b.name: Maris Granger
1292|ec1a6e0b.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

1297|ed056522.name: Lina Stover
1297|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1298|ed056522.name: Frederick Stover
1298|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1302|e86e31c2.name: Bernard Gump
1302|e86e31c2.text: We are the only supplier of healthy flowers in all of Stormwind. We provide beautiful blooms for any occasion.

1303|e86e31c2.name: Felicia Gump
1303|e86e31c2.text: We are the only supplier of healthy flowers in all of Stormwind. We provide beautiful blooms for any occasion.

13084|554a4659.name: Bixi Wobblebonk
13084|554a4659.text: Well hi there!  Are you here to learn the proper technique of a new weapon?

1320|877c4b1d.name: Seoman Griffith
1320|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1321|877c4b1d.name: Alyssa Griffith
1321|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1327|a381f669.name: Reese Langston
1327|a381f669.text: Welcome to the Pig and Whistle! Grab a drink my friend and pull up a seat, the more the merrier!

1351|a96dc031.name: Brother Cassius
1351|a96dc031.text: May the light guide your path and aid you in your journies. If you need any assistance browsing, I will be right over here.

1460|fccbd4ef.name: Unger Statforth
1460|fccbd4ef.text:
Sorry, but I am not disposed to sell horses to any individual who is not considered to be at least exalted to the Kingdom of Stormwind.  These steeds are the finest you'll find anywhere, and we certainly wouldn't want them in the hands of our enemies.

Not saying you're an enemy, of course... just earn the trust of Stormwind and then we can do business.

1464|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Helbrek
1464|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1480|4d61ac25.name: Caitlin Grassman
1480|4d61ac25.text: Alchemy can help so many people! It's my life's passion.

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1680|279d82d3.name: Matthew Hooper
1680|279d82d3.text: Your skill exceeds mine, though  I've heard that Old Man Heming in Booty Bay has copies of "The Bass and You".  That is sure to help you increase your skill.

2094|28b1f157.name: James Halloran
2094|28b1f157.text: Greetings, $c. I'm in a bit of a pinch right now, running very low on hides.

2327|2957a3a0.name: Shaina Fuller
2327|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

2329|a28d29e1.name: Michelle Belle
2329|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2455|105cd232.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2456|2237a3b1.name: Newton Burnside
2456|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

2481|014b9d07.name: Bliztik
2481|014b9d07.text:
A customer all the way out here? What luck! This place was a goldmine of empty alchemy bottles. Kinda weird.

Don't worry, I washed 'em out.

256390|6a190ff9.name: Marcy Baker
256390|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256734|edaae191.name: Daniel Stitchsong
256734|edaae191.text: Hello there! I've got the finest leathers this side of Stormwind. Interested?

256742|424df33e.name: Dianne Softstep
256742|424df33e.text:
Ah, I am afraid you and I have no business at this time.

If you end up fulfilling some contracts with the trade authority, then perhaps we will have something to discuss later.

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

273|1299e7cb.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
273|1299e7cb.text: Keep the door closed, $C.  Never know when the Dark Riders will be passing through again.

2786|c9907ea0.name: Gerrig Bonegrip
2786|c9907ea0.text:
Welcome to Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms, $c.  You may look, but do not touch.

Some of the knowledge here is not meant for the...uninitiated.

2879|0e051c59.name: Karrina Mekenda
2879|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

288|07ae01e9.name: Jitters
288|07ae01e9.text: Huh?!?  Oh.  You don't look like a Defias thief...or a member of the Night Watch.  Take pity on a poor soul, will ya?

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

3179|c2467ddc.name: Harold Riggs
3179|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

3181|a28d29e1.name: Fremal Doohickey
3181|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3616|29aa26bd.name: Onu
3616|29aa26bd.text:
The wind whispers to those who listen...

Do you hear it?

3691|3e6c050b.name: Raene Wolfrunner
3691|3e6c050b.text: I know these forests as if they were a part of me... But know that there is still much to be learned from them, and much danger still hidden.

3692|6e5dc9aa.name: Volcor
3692|6e5dc9aa.text:
Well, the way I see it, $N, we have two options to consider for leaving this cave.

We can make our way stealthfully--I use the cloak you've given me, and you'd be left to your own devices, or, and this may be a harder option considering my wounds, we fight our way out back to back.

I'll let you decide since you know your strengths better than I.

3692|966370fe.name: Volcor
3692|966370fe.text:
<Volcor doesn't look at you at all as you get close to him. He seems to be concentrating on keeping his bandages from falling off. After a moment, he looks up at you, a little startled.>

Oh, sorry, $c. Now's not a good time. I hope you understand.

3693|85fc41cc.name: Terenthis
3693|85fc41cc.text:
$N, I've come to find out how rampant the effects of Fel Moss are throughout Darkshore. The corruption of Teldrassil and our surrounding lands really concerns the druids of the Cenarian Circle, and all Night elves.

It is my goal to find out why this has happened and to put an end to it.

3698|0e051c59.name: Bolyun
3698|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

3702|5ae56d71.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
3702|5ae56d71.text: Hello $r, it is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

3885|d83258b9.name: Sentinel Velene Starstrike
3885|d83258b9.text:
Have you seen the befouled water elementals in our lake, $N? It is a sorry sight, but I do not know where they are coming from.

Your name has been mentioned in conversations past, perhaps you could help me with this problem.

The first thing we must learn is who is in control of these elementals.

392|9183bb21.name: Captain Grayson
392|9183bb21.text: Do not be alarmed, $r.  I have long since passed from this land but I intend no harm to your kind.  I have witnessed too much death in my time.  My only wish now is for peace.  Perhaps you can help my cause.

3963|c8a70fb5.name: Danlaar Nightstride
3963|c8a70fb5.text: What can I do for you my child?

3967|01c9a17b.name: Aayndia Floralwind
3967|01c9a17b.text: Always double-check your measurements before you begin to cut the leather. We cannot afford to waste materials.

4077|a1373701.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
4077|a1373701.text:
If I can get the proper ingredients, we can create some explosives that will not only allow me to damage the Venture's Co.'s operations, but also cause a distraction.

I know you're impressed, but it gets better... I'll tell you more soon enough.

4078|8a5b6577.name: Collin Mauren
4078|8a5b6577.text: Hello, friend. What can I do for you?

4205|ab633da8.name: Dorion
4205|ab633da8.text: Welcome to the Cenarion Circle, $c.  How may I assist you?

4210|3b48d638.name: Alegorn
4210|3b48d638.text: Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.

4210|52392408.name: Alegorn
4210|52392408.text: Seek out Shandrina in Silverwind Refuge.  She can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".

4211|a28d29e1.name: Dannelor
4211|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

4267|c5ceacbe.name: Daelyshia
4267|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4320|0e051c59.name: Caelyb
4320|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

4407|c5ceacbe.name: Teloren
4407|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5482|3b48d638.name: Stephen Ryback
5482|3b48d638.text: Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.

5483|877c4b1d.name: Erika Tate
5483|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5515|4a5716a3.name: Einris Brightspear
5515|4a5716a3.text: Look at the wisdom and knowledge of the beast, and you will see yourself. Observe as the owl does, learn cleverness from the sabercat, embody the mighty spirit of the wolf.

5516|4a5716a3.name: Ulfir Ironbeard
5516|4a5716a3.text: Look at the wisdom and knowledge of the beast, and you will see yourself. Observe as the owl does, learn cleverness from the sabercat, embody the mighty spirit of the wolf.

5564|568f7020.name: Simon Tanner
5564|568f7020.text: Hmm, I guess I can take on another student. Well, don't just stand there. Tell me what you're looking to learn.

5565|877c4b1d.name: Jillian Tanner
5565|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

6301|7a1efc7f.name: Gorbold Steelhand
6301|7a1efc7f.text: Greetings lad, if you're looking for the best deals you'll find outside of Ironforge itself, then you've come to the right place.

633|b8d58f51.name: Elaine Carevin
633|b8d58f51.text: It's dark times that have come, $c... All too soon will we lose everything... When the Light will forsake all but those who truly walk under the Light.

6669|a5e43d8e.name: The Threshwackonator 4100
6669|a5e43d8e.text: Gelkak's key slides into the vacant slot.

6735|41276936.name: Innkeeper Saelienne
6735|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6738|41276936.name: Innkeeper Kimlya
6738|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6790|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Trelayne
6790|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

8308|c8a70fb5.name: Alenndaar Lapidaar
8308|c8a70fb5.text: What can I do for you my child?

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1008-progress.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1008-progress.text: We cannot allow the naga to invade our coasts, $N.  It is vital that you go to the Zoram Strand and complete your mission.
1008-progress.title: The Zoram Strand

1009-progress.name: Talen
1009-progress.text: It is said that the Ring of Zoram is the key to any lock within the city.  Do you have it, $N?
1009-progress.title: Ruuzel

1010-progress.name: Orendil Broadleaf
1010-progress.text: Have you gathered the Bathran's Hair, $N?  The child's health grows weaker by the hour...
1010-progress.title: Bathran's Hair

1016-progress.name: Sentinel Velene Starstrike
1016-progress.text: Since you must destroy the bracers to kill the elementals, it will probably be difficult to find the specific ones that contain the information the divining scroll needs. You can trade bracers with others in order to obtain the ones you need, or perhaps you have the divined paper already?
1016-progress.title: Elemental Bracers

1020-progress.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1020-progress.text: I must apologize, for I have no time to speak.  My child, Relara, is deathly ill!
1020-progress.title: Orendil's Cure

103-progress.name: Captain Grayson
103-progress.text: The flame will not burn for long without oil, $N.
103-progress.title: Keeper of the Flame

1033-progress.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1033-progress.text: $N, did you find Iris Lake?  Do you have the Tear?
1033-progress.title: Elune's Tear

1034-progress.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1034-progress.text: Do you yet have the Stardust, $N?
1034-progress.title: The Ruins of Stardust

1035-progress.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1035-progress.text: Did you face the Shadethicket Oracle, $N?  If so, then please hand me the fallen moonstone.  Relara has strength left for only a few more breaths!
1035-progress.title: Fallen Sky Lake

104-progress.name: Captain Grayson
104-progress.text:
Have you laid waste to the menace known as Old Murk-Eye yet?  He has been spotted roaming the coastline of Westfall.

Return to me when the foul beast is dead.
104-progress.title: The Coastal Menace

1054-progress.name: Raene Wolfrunner
1054-progress.text: The furbolgs' corruption has caused Ashenvale to become a fraction of its former glory.
1054-progress.title: Culling the Threat

1076-progress.name: Collin Mauren
1076-progress.text: Hello, $N. Have you found the component I need?
1076-progress.title: Devils in Westfall

1093-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-progress.text: Did you find those plans? I'm eager to impress the new boss. Hopefully, once he's convinced of my loyalty--well, as much as he can be convinced... goblin's honor, you know?--he'll feel comfortable making use of my rather impressive genius.
1093-progress.title: Super Reaper 6000

1134-progress.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1134-progress.text: Do you have the pridewing venom sacs, $N?  We cannot allow the orcs to use the beasts' poisons against us!
1134-progress.title: Pridewings of Stonetalon

149-progress.name: Blind Mary
149-progress.text:
<Sob> Oh please, don't look at me!  I tore out these eyes with my own hands, but I can still feel your gaze!

I'm hideous!  Hideous!  Please, look away!!
149-progress.title: Ghost Hair Thread

154-progress.name: Madame Eva
154-progress.text: I sense that you have seen Blind Mary.  You have my Comb...?
154-progress.title: Return the Comb

156-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
156-progress.text: Hi, $N.  Do you have those rot blossoms for me yet?
156-progress.title: Gather Rot Blossoms

157-progress.name: Abercrombie
157-progress.text: I need to string the Ghost Hair Thread along my door and my windows to keep out unwanted spirits.  Did you get it for me?
157-progress.title: Deliver the Thread

164-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
164-progress.text: You look a sturdy type, $c. Have you come to join our fight?
164-progress.title: Deliveries to Sven

174-progress.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
174-progress.text: Have you found a skilled engineer to create a bronze tube yet?
174-progress.title: Look to the Stars

177-progress.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
177-progress.text: I showed Cog the beginnings of our star-viewing machine.  He was impressed.  Did you happen to find a reflective device?
177-progress.title: Look to the Stars

180-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-progress.text: What news do you bring before the Court?
180-progress.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

2098-progress.name: Gelkak Gyromast
2098-progress.text: Have ye found me broke down key, landlubber?
2098-progress.title: Gyromast's Retrieval

230-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
230-progress.text: You found what??  Please, let me see it...
230-progress.title: Sven's Camp

240-progress.name: Jitters
240-progress.text: $N, you're here!  Do you have my food?!?
240-progress.title: Return to Jitters

262-progress.name: Madame Eva
262-progress.text: If you have something that belongs to the shadowy figure for whom you seek, then let me see it.  I may be able to divine something of its owner.
262-progress.title: The Shadowy Figure

265-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
265-progress.text:
Sometimes I'll sell blank books to scholars and mages, or to anyone who wants to keep a journal.

I remember well everyone to whom I sold a book within the last few months...
265-progress.title: The Shadowy Search Continues

266-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
266-progress.text:
The Scarlet Raven doesn't see the business it used to, but we still do get travelers passing through.

If you can describe the person you're looking for, maybe I'll remember him.
266-progress.title: Inquire at the Inn

268-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
268-progress.text: Did you find who the Shadowy Figure was?
268-progress.title: Return to Sven

279-progress.name: Karl Boran
279-progress.text: Our merchants will not be safe until we are rid of Gobbler and those Murlocs.
279-progress.title: Claws from the Deep

288-progress.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
288-progress.text: Oh, I'm so very thirsty! Won't you buy a drink for this poor, pathetic fool?
288-progress.title: The Third Fleet

289-progress.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
289-progress.text: In my dreams, I can sometimes hear the doomed moans of my brethren! Please, good sir, free them from the bonds and quiet their cries.
289-progress.title: The Cursed Crew

296-progress.name: Ormer Ironbraid
296-progress.text: Is Sarltooth dead? Have you redeemed the memory of the fallen?
296-progress.title: Ormer's Revenge

299-progress.name: Prospector Whelgar
299-progress.text: Have you uncovered the four fragments yet, $N?  Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru...
299-progress.title: Uncovering the Past

306-progress.name: Tarrel Rockweaver
306-progress.text: Were you able to find Merrin? Did she send word?
306-progress.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

34-progress.name: Martie Jainrose
34-progress.text: Is Bellygrub still at it or were you able to rid Lakeshire of the pest once and for all?
34-progress.title: An Unwelcome Guest

453-progress.name: Jitters
453-progress.text: Who are you??  Leave me be!
453-progress.title: Finding the Shadowy Figure

4727-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4727-progress.text: Hello once again $N - have you found any more beached creatures that the Temple of the Moon should know about?
4727-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4763-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
4763-progress.text: The Talisman of Corruption is a sinister device that only serves to pervert the balance of nature.  When you obtain this item from whatever satyr is tormenting the furbolgs and bring it to me for disposal, we will have won a great victory this day!
4763-progress.title: The Blackwood Corrupted

484-progress.name: James Halloran
484-progress.text: $N, right? Do you have my skins?
484-progress.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

68-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
68-progress.text: Ah, I remember you.  You're the one who was asking about that Stalvan fellow.  Did you ever find what you were looking for?
68-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

70-progress.name: Caretaker Folsom
70-progress.text: What have ya got there?  Let me take a look at that. . .
70-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

741-progress.name: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker
741-progress.text: What can I do for you, $r?
741-progress.title: The Absent Minded Prospector

90-progress.name: Chef Grual
90-progress.text: Were you able to find 10 Lean Wolf Flanks yet?
90-progress.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs

91-progress.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-progress.text: Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
91-progress.title: Solomon's Law

93-progress.name: Chef Grual
93-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Did you get those Gooey Spider Legs yet?
93-progress.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

943-progress.name: Archaeologist Flagongut
943-progress.text: With the Stone of Relu I will be able to release the hidden secrets of my fossil as well as Remtravel's fossil from Darkshore, $N.
943-progress.title: The Absent Minded Prospector

951-progress.name: Onu
951-progress.text: $N.  Has your rooting through the Ruins of Mathystra been fruitful?
951-progress.title: Mathystra Relics

967-progress.name: Delgren the Purifier
967-progress.text: You have some business with me, $c?
967-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

968-progress.name: Gerrig Bonegrip
968-progress.text:
Hello, sir.

May I interest you in one of my tomes?
968-progress.title: The Powers Below

970-progress.name: Delgren the Purifier
970-progress.text: Have you acquired that soul gem?
970-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

973-progress.name: Delgren the Purifier
973-progress.text: You look a bit shaken up, $N. Are you well?
973-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx
